serialization: camelCase; all documented nullable fields are present

errors.409: cursor belongs to a different snapshot

Resource.id: ca_ plus first 24 lowercase hex characters of SHA-256 of canonical URL
Resource.title: official title
Resource.url: canonical https://academy.claude.com public course, collection, tutorial or use-case page
categoryIds: slugs of Academy collections whose pages list this resource
tags: product and role labels shown on the page, such as Claude Code or Sales

duration.courseMinutes: estimated minutes shown on the page (courses, tutorials, use cases) or null

units.title: official lesson, quiz or member title
units.url: official lesson page of the course, or the member resource page

sourceUrls: the resource page, then the collection pages that list it

MediaReference.note: Reserved for contract compatibility. Resources never carry media.

Category.label: collection title from its public page

Coverage.discovered: member links on the collection page, or null when the page was not read

snapshotBehavior: Public requests only read a validated local snapshot. They never crawl or fetch source pages. Failed refresh keeps the last valid snapshot. Age greater than 7 days reports stale by default.
staticServing: Optional --frontend-dir. API routes are registered first. Fingerprinted assets are immutable; index/documents are no-cache. SPA fallback never handles /v1, /health, /openapi.json or API documentation routes.

ArtworkReference.url: https://academy.claude.com/og/<section>/<slug>.(png|jpg|jpeg|webp), the share image of this exact page

artworkBehavior: Optional public source metadata distinct from license-controlled media. The image is hotlinked from the official site, never downloaded, proxied or re-hosted, and no reuse permission is asserted. Site-wide fallback images do not count; missing artwork serializes as null.

conditionalRequests.validator: Weak ETag of the complete normalized JSON representation; If-None-Match supports weak/strong equivalents, lists and *.
conditionalRequests.notModified: 304, empty body, same ETag/cache policy; request validation and cursor checks run first.
conditionalRequests.uncached: All HTTP errors, /health* and a /v1/status whose state is unavailable use no-store and no ETag.
conditionalRequests.cors: If-None-Match request header permitted; ETag response header exposed; origin * without credentials.
conditionalRequests.edgeKey: Full query string; only successful public GET catalog and status responses. No error caching.
conditionalRequests.frontend: Catalog HTML public, max-age=3600; hashed /assets/ bundles public, max-age=31536000, immutable; other static files public, max-age=86400.
conditionalRequests.publication: Changed representation changes ETag. The collector purges the deployment hostname from the edge cache after each publication; without a purge, shared caches may serve the previous representation, including a time-derived status state, for up to a day. Browsers may reuse a catalog response for a day, and for up to seven more days while revalidating or when the origin fails; clients that need the latest snapshot compare snapshotId from /v1/status, which browsers recheck after five minutes. A stale cursor can return 409 and must restart with unchanged filters.

audienceNote: Accepted for compatibility with the OpenAI Academy API. Claude Academy pages publish no audience, so audiences is always [].
levelNote: Claude Academy pages publish no level, so level is null.
collection: Deterministic, operator-run collector: robots.txt is parsed first and checked for every URL; the sitemap lists the pages; collection pages are read first and their member links add pages the sitemap misses; requests are sequential, GET only, at least 1.1 seconds apart, with an identifying User-Agent. A page that fails keeps its last record; a page that leaves the sitemap leaves the snapshot. Lesson pages are linked, never fetched. No model or agent is involved.
